receipts.initial: Initial state: no elements processed; no highlighted interval, deque or cumulative output.
receipts.partial: After update: partial interval [0, 0], values [1]; no output yet. Elements to the right are unprocessed.
receipts.scope: After update: full window [2, 4], values [-1, -3, 5]; indices to the left have expired, elements to the right are unprocessed. Output retains maxima of all completed windows.
receipts.legend: Cells show zero-based indices above values. Deque notation is index:value; for example, 1:3 means nums[1]=3. Changing preset restarts this trace.
receipts.baseline: Let n=len(nums). Scan all k values in each of n−k+1 windows: exactly (n−k+1)k value visits, taking O((n−k+1)k) time, bounded by O(nk). Adjacent windows reread k−1 values. For n=100000 and k=50000, this is 50001×50000=2500050000 value visits; at k=n there is only one window and n visits.

receipts.initial: 初始状态：尚未处理任何元素；无高亮区间，队列与累计输出均为空。
receipts.partial: 更新后：不足 k 个元素的区间 [0, 0]，值 [1]；尚不输出。右侧元素尚未处理。
receipts.scope: 更新后：完整窗口 [2, 4]，值 [-1, -3, 5]；左侧索引已过期，右侧元素尚未处理。输出保留所有已完成窗口的最大值。
receipts.removed: 本步移除：1 (已过期), 3 (被新值支配), 2 (被新值支配)
receipts.legend: 格子上方是从 0 开始的索引，下方是值。队列记法 索引:值，例如 1:3 表示 nums[1]=3。切换预设会重置此轨迹。
receipts.baseline: 令 n=len(nums)。每个窗口扫描全部 k 个值；共有 n−k+1 个窗口，因此恰好读取 (n−k+1)k 个值，时间为 O((n−k+1)k)，上界 O(nk)。相邻窗口重复读取 k−1 个值。例如 n=100000、k=50000 时，读取 50001×50000=2500050000 个值；而 k=n 时只有一个窗口，只需读取 n 个值。
